items.title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
items.excerpt: StepCAD combines a CAD policy conditioned on target and intermediate geometry with IoU-guided tree search. ARCADE-1.5M contains 1.5 million executable programs and 12.5 million intermediate transitions. Reconstruction improvements are author-reported benchmark results, not production validation.

items.title: Scale-Split Neural Operator for Memory- and Data-Efficient 3D Turbulence Prediction
items.excerpt: ScaleSplit-NO couples a coarse-field Parent with a local-patch Child, avoiding full-resolution fields in either model. On JHTDB256 the authors report 53% lower NMSE than the strongest baseline and 79% lower training memory than the most memory-efficient baseline; these are different comparators.

items.title: SINO: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator
items.excerpt: SINO uses spectral and spatial branches and low-rank continuous kernels to learn turbulence closure on normalized physical scales. The authors report error and parameter-efficiency gains over multiple baselines and provide code. Results are research benchmarks, not a general CFD replacement.

items.title: Cross-Organizational SysML Model Integration: A Survey of Challenges and AI-Supported Tasks
items.excerpt: An online questionnaire of 29 MBSE stakeholders rated eight integration challenges and six AI task types on five-point scales. Respondents favored semantic analysis and inconsistency detection with human verification. Small perception survey; it does not measure deployed AI productivity.

items.title: Autodesk advances AI for design and manufacturing at AU 2026
items.excerpt: Autodesk announced AutoTimeline to convert imported geometry into editable parametric parts, AutoAssemble, System Modeler and an agentic PLM experience. Inventor Assistant can modify models through APIs and iLogic. Announcement language mixes available and forthcoming capabilities; do not imply all are generally available.

items.title: System-Level Modeling and Agentic AI Take the Spotlight in COMSOL Multiphysics Version 2027
items.excerpt: COMSOL announced version 2027 for later this fall, with system diagrams coupled to multiphysics models and an MCP server for agents to build models, run simulations and inspect results. The Electric Motor Module and macOS/Linux Application Builder were also announced. This is a future release, not current general availability.

items.title: Siemens accelerates physical testing with Simcenter Testlab
items.excerpt: Siemens updated Testlab Neo structural dynamics workflows, system NVH prediction, contextualized AI-ready data preparation and virtual shaker testing for aerospace qualification. Claimed gains of up to 35% in structural testing and 60% in NVH prediction are vendor-reported, with different workflow scopes.

items.title: Rayon raises €10M Series A to bring AI into interior design software
items.excerpt: Partech led Rayon’s €10 million Series A with Northzone, Foundamental and Seedcamp. The browser CAD vendor says V4 will add 3D and AI before year-end. Existing floor-plan vectorization is distinguished from the forthcoming 3D release; usage and customer savings in the release are self-reported.

items.title: Accelerating next-generation battery design through simulation
items.excerpt: Anna De Gol describes Siemens/VUB doctoral research on simulation for solid-state battery design and the coupled mechanical, ionic-transport and interface challenges. The series presents potential innovations without guaranteed product delivery. This is a research overview, not evidence of a released battery technology.

items.title: NOAH: Neural Operator Algebra in Hilbert Space
items.excerpt: F-NOAH adds constrained advection, diffusion and reaction generators to an FNO backbone. Authors test 500 initial conditions over 50 epochs on 2D Navier–Stokes at a single viscosity, with resolution transfer. Primary search extract verified metadata and scope; direct page fetch failed, so full evaluation remains unchecked.

items.title: A Coupled Neural Operator Proxy for Fast Full-Field Pressure and Oil-Saturation Forecasting in Two-Phase Petroleum Reservoir Simulation
items.excerpt: The paper describes coupled global-local neural-operator pressure and saturation forecasts for two-phase reservoirs. Publisher metadata lists reproducibility code, checkpoints, metrics and a dataset manifest. Direct fetch returned 429, so the paper is retained with abstract/metadata-level evidence rather than verified performance claims.

items.title: Transforming Rotating Machinery Blade Design with AI
items.excerpt: A September article describes the July-start FORGE project with MIT and Maryland: nine months developing generative blade designs, AI surrogates and inverse design. Minutes-versus-hours evaluations are a project ambition, not demonstrated results. New page date must not be mistaken for a new funding award.

items.title: Standardization at Scale: How OEMs Can Embed Their Design DNA into Generative Design Software
items.excerpt: Transcend describes encoding OEM sizing rules, cost models, performance parameters and design standards into automated infrastructure optioneering. It cites Nereda process integration in TDG. This is a dated implementation-oriented vendor explanation, not a new product release or independently measured productivity result.

items.title: Multiphase CFD simulation of liquid injection in a screw compressor
items.excerpt: Jan Hesse’s September conference presentation examines multiphase positive-displacement-machine simulation in STAR-CCM+, including phase interactions, model choices and mesh resolution. TwinMesh supplies time-varying chamber meshes. Adjacent engineering-method signal; it is not an AI release.

items.title: A large-scale benchmark to assess vision-language model question answering capabilities in engineering simulations
items.excerpt: OpenSeeSimE contains over 200,000 question-answer pairs across 10,000 simulations. Ten VLMs achieved near-chance accuracy of 29–47% in the reported tests. This accepted early article establishes domain-specific baselines; its findings do not show that every future VLM or engineering task performs at chance.

items.title: New and improved: Build apps, extend agents, and transform business processes in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.excerpt: September update: apps and Managed Runtime in public preview; deterministic hooks in preview; Foundry IQ integration and Review panel generally available. Adds automation evaluations, task/tool/safety graders and governance controls.

items.title: Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes

items.title: Securing Cross-Facility AI Model Training
items.excerpt: OLCF is preparing federated-learning access after a June demonstration with Japan’s AIST using NVIDIA FLARE. Integration work lets FLARE recognize Frontier’s non-NVIDIA GPUs; local datasets stay at participating institutions.
items.summary: The September update concerns engineering and service preparation, not a new September intercontinental experiment. Availability is forthcoming, not confirmed general access; federated learning alone does not prove all privacy risks eliminated.

items.title: EU projects to empower researchers with more efficient, competitive and inclusive tools
items.category: 科学AI・デジタルツイン
items.excerpt: REA announced €411 million for 73 research-infrastructure projects, including AI-powered simulations and digital twins. CLAIMA is planned as a European AI climate-digital-twin platform; ESG4Stars targets sustainable scientific computing.
items.summary: Funding covers multiple research-infrastructure destinations, not exclusively AI or digital twins. Eighteen INFRATECH projects address instrumentation and advanced digital methods; all 73 were selected from 159 proposals submitted in a 2025 call. Platform capabilities are planned outcomes, not validated performance.

items.title: How to create a new ISPU configuration starting from a C template
items.excerpt: An ST employee provides a C-template workflow for on-sensor algorithms, using MEMS Studio and the ISPU toolchain with the IIS3DWB10IS evaluation kit. Public examples support custom signal processing and edge-AI deployment.
items.summary: Practical integration tutorial, not a new accuracy benchmark. Demonstrated application is a simple counter; the method can support more complex algorithms. Source links code at https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/st-mems-ispu . Do not describe the tutorial as proving production anomaly-detection results.

items.title: Robotic help in high-risk twin pregnancies
items.excerpt: ETH and clinical collaborators developed magnetically controlled flexible endoscopy for fetal surgery. A preclinical animal-model study combines panoramic visualization, magnetic navigation and laser treatment.
items.summary: Reference paper: Advancing minimally invasive precision surgery in large open cavities with robotic flexible endoscopy, Science Robotics, September 16. This is a robotics wildcard, not an AI-agent system; clinical safety, efficacy and regulatory readiness are not established by the institutional summary.

items.title: Exascale Multiphysics Simulations for Liquid Metal Fusion Blankets
items.category: HPC・工学シミュレーション
items.excerpt: A Penn State-led project couples GPU-native NekRS with OpenMC for fusion-blanket multiphysics. ALCF reports meshes exceeding two trillion grid points and near-full-machine scaling on Aurora and Frontier.
items.summary: The September case study links a forthcoming November SC26 paper. Institution-reported results include near-ideal scaling beyond 9,000 nodes and 20–30% runtime reduction from mixed precision and communication overlap. AI-driven design is a future use of resulting data, not the demonstrated solver method. Preserve distinction between publication date of case study and future conference.
